instruction: Get Mux to repair the jammed door between the back room and the bar.

target.reason: The instruction wants the jammed door actually repaired, but the page offers no verb for repairing anything (only depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept, refuse), and none of the representable end states—someone holding an item, someone being in a room, or someone having said something—corresponds to the door being fixed. At most Mux could be paid or persuaded to talk, but that would not be the door repaired.
